title: Drying, salting and smoking, cleanly and safely

say: Drying, salting and smoking, cleanly and safely.
This is the video for module 2 of Food Preservation and Storage.
Drying is the cheapest method in a sunny country. But careless drying gives dusty, mouldy food.
Dry on mesh trays raised off the ground, never on a mat or zinc on the floor. Cover with net against flies, dust and lizards.

panel.heading: Five drying rules
items: Raised mesh trays, covered with net

Single layer, pieces the same thickness
Bring trays in at night
Clean hands, knives and water

say: Mesh lets air pass under the food, so both sides dry at once.

say: Wash produce in safe water, and wash your hands and knives. A solar dryer with a clear cover and netted vents is faster and cleaner still.

say: Pieces on the edge dry faster than the middle, so some may still hold water. Before long storage, condition the batch. Fill a clean, dry jar about two-thirds full.

say: Close it and shake it once a day for about a week. If drops of water form, or pieces stick together, spread the food out and dry it more.

say: If it stays loose and dry, let it cool and pack it in small airtight packs, in a cool, dark place. Check every week.

say: For example, Funmi in Kaduna dried 4 kg of tomatoes and got 400 g. Her drying ratio is 10, so 1 kg of dried tomato needs about 10 kg fresh. Always weigh your own batch.

say: Salt pulls water out of flesh, but slowly, from the outside in. Start with very fresh fish: bright clear eyes, red gills, firm flesh. Salt will not rescue stale fish.

panel.heading: Dry-salted fish
items: Very fresh fish only: clear eyes, red gills
Gut, remove gills, wash the belly cavity
Split thick fish so salt reaches the centre
Salt every surface; layer, cover, keep cool
Drain the pickle, rinse off loose salt
Dry on raised, covered racks until firm

say: Gut it, remove the gills, and wash the belly well. The gut spoils fastest.

say: Dry it on raised, covered racks until firm right through. A soft, wet or pink centre, or a sour smell, means throw it away. Lightly salted fish that is not dried, smoked or kept cold is not preserved.

panel.rule: Salting must be followed by drying, smoking or cold storage.

say: Hot-smoking cooks, dries and coats the fish in one process. Soft-smoked fish is moist. Treat it like cooked fish: fridge, and eat within days. Never seal it airtight at room temperature.

panel.heading: Soft-smoked or hard-smoked?
right: Dry, firm, light for its size
Airy basket in a dry place

say: Hard-smoked fish keeps for weeks. Smoke slowly: gentle heat dries the surface, hotter heat cooks it through, then low heat dries it for keeping.
The flesh must be opaque right to the bone. If the centre is soft and damp, give it more time on low heat, not more fire.

panel.heading: Soft-smoked or hard-smoked?
right: Dry, firm, light for its size
Airy basket in a dry place

say: Use only dry, untreated hardwood, coconut husk or charcoal. Plastic, tyres and treated wood release poisonous smoke that settles on the food.

cards.d: Dry, untreated hardwood, coconut husk or charcoal. Never plastic, tyres or painted wood.
Keep fish well above the flames. Aim for a steady smoulder, not a blaze.
Smoke outdoors with a chimney. Children away. Water or sand nearby. Cotton, not synthetic clothes.

say: Keep fish well above the flames. Burnt, charred fish carries more harmful smoke substances.

say: Wood smoke harms your lungs and eyes. Smoke outdoors or under an open shed, with a chimney carrying smoke away from your face. Keep children away, keep water or sand nearby, and wear cotton clothes.

say: For example, Rukayat in Lokoja hard-smokes 10 kg of live catfish.

card.title: The real cost of smoked catfish

say: The fish costs about 35,000 naira, with about 4,000 naira of firewood and 500 naira of salt.

card.title: The real cost of smoked catfish

say: That is 39,500 naira. The finished fish weighs 3.5 kg, so about 35% of the fresh weight remains. Each kilogram costs her about 11,300 naira before packaging and labour.
So she prices from that figure, not from the fresh price.

card.title: The real cost of smoked catfish

say: To remember. Dry raised and covered, and bring trays in at night. Condition before you pack. Salt only fresh fish and always dry, smoke or chill it after. Smoke with clean fuel, outdoors. And weigh before and after, so you know your real cost.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Dry raised, covered, single layer; in at night
Condition dried food in a jar for a week
Salt only very fresh fish, then dry it fully
Clean fuel, no charring, smoke outdoors
Weigh before and after to know your real cost
